card.statement:
Let $T\to X$ be a closed subscheme. The induced map $\mathcal{F}_{T}\to\mathcal{F}_{X}$ is an objectwise closed immersion of affine schemes.

•

The open complement $\mathcal{F}_{X\smallsetminus T}$ is the fiber functor defined as

$\mathcal{F}_{X\smallsetminus T}(S/X)=\mathcal{F}_{X}(S/X)\smallsetminus\mathcal{F}_{T}(S/X)=S\smallsetminus(S\times_{X}T).$

•

The formal neighborhood of $T$ inside $X$ is the fiber functor $\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{T}}}$ sending $(S\to X)$ to the ind-scheme formal completion of $\mathcal{F}_{T}(S)=S\mathbin{\operatorname*{\times}_{X}}T$ inside $S$.

•

The affine formal neighborhood of $T$ inside $X$ is the fiber functor $\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{T}}}^{\mathrm{aff}}$ which sends $(S\to X)$ to the affinized formal completion of $\mathcal{F}_{T}(S)$ inside $S$. More concretely,

$\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{T}}}^{\mathrm{aff}}(S/X)=\Spec\mathopen{}\mathclose{{\left(\Gamma(\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{T}}}(S/X),\mathcal{O}_{\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{T}}}(S/X)})}}\right).$

•

The punctured formal neighborhood $\mathcal{F}_{\widehat{T}\smallsetminus T}$ is the fiber functor defined as

$\mathcal{F}_{\widehat{T}\smallsetminus T}(S/X)=\mathcal{F}_{{\widehat{T}}}^{\mathrm{aff}}(S/X)\smallsetminus\mathcal{F}_{T}(S/X).$
card.label: Definition 2.1

paper.title: Two dimensional versions of the affine Grassmannian and their geometric description
paper.abstract: For a smooth affine algebraic group $G$ over an algebraically closed field, we consider several two-variables generalizations of the affine Grassmannian $G(\!(t)\!)/G[\![t]\!]$, given by quotients of the double loop group $G(\!(x)\!)(\!(y)\!)$. We prove that they are representable by ind-schemes if $G$ is solvable. Given a smooth surface $X$ and a flag of subschemes of $X$, we provide a geometric interpretation of the two-variables Grassmannians, in terms of bundles and trivialisation data defined on appropriate loci in $X$, which depend on the flag.
